login.description: Sign in to see sensors and alarms.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePassword.forcedDescription: This is your first sign-in. Set your own password to continue.

errors.tooShort: The new password must be at least {{count}} characters long
errors.mismatch: The new passwords do not match
errors.sameAsOld: The new password must be different from the current one

form.title: New account
form.description: The login is filled in from the full name. At first sign-in the user sets their own password.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long
errors.rangeRequired: A forester must have a forest range

edit.title: Edit account
edit.activeHint: An inactive account cannot sign in and its session ends at once.
edit.selfHint: You cannot deactivate your own account or change your own role.
edit.resetHint: The backend draws a new temporary password. The current password stops working and the user sets their own at sign-in.

created.title: Account created
created.description: Pass these details on to the user. The password cannot be viewed later.

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.added: Sensor {{id}} added. The forester will mount it in the app.

form.title: New sensor
form.description: The sensor will show up on the forester’s list to mount. The phone saves its location when mounting.
form.idHint: 16 characters from the sticker on the sensor. Spaces and dashes are removed.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.nameHint: Usually the forester names it when mounting.

errors.invalidId: The sensor ID must have 16 characters: digits 0–9 and letters A–F

edit.title: Edit sensor
edit.description: After changing the forest range, the sensor is shown to the forester of the new range.
